name: Coconut Sugar
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as it's quickly absorbed in the small intestine at moderate amounts.
preparationTips: Use 1:1 ratio to replace regular sugar in recipes
Store in airtight container to prevent clumping
Has slight caramel flavor that works well in baked goods
nutritionalHighlights: Contains trace minerals like potassium and zinc
Lower glycemic index than regular sugar
